title: hooks-v1 event: decision.ask
description: a conductor question for a `hook` decision provider (SRV-851): the question as the provider maps it, and the text it is about at payload redacted or full. The hook answers {action: decide, decision: {answer: <option id> | {choice, confidence?, probabilities?}}}; an id that is not one of `options`, a continue or a failure falls back to the built-in answer.

id.description: the question id: classify, packages, deliverable, memory_intent, memory_gate or judge

instructions.description: the question in words, as the conductor asks it

options.description: option id -> what it means; the answer is one of these ids

model.description: the model the provider maps for this question (auto: the hook's own choice)

deadline_ms.description: the time the answer may take, at most the stage's 400 ms

state_chars.description: the length of the text the question is about (content.state)

content.description: payload redacted or full only (redacted: every string through the redaction)

state.description: the text the question is about: the conductor's digest of the user's message, the session or the tool output
